verification_rule: A source is VERIFIED only when substantive body text was actually retrieved. Entrance-only or iframe-only pages are not promoted to VERIFIED content sources.

sources.title: 競輪関係 - 関係規程
sources.evidence_location: Current index lists competition operations, rider management, bicycle inspection, program formation, judging, vehicle safety, and bicycle race implementation rules.

sources.title: 自転車競走実施規則
sources.evidence_location: Arts. 13-25 roles; Arts. 31-35 race/bicycle/field rules; Arts. 40-46 eligibility, inspection, participation confirmation/cancellation; Chapter 8 betting/refund. PDF pp.3-10 and later sections.

sources.title: 競輪の番組編成の要領
sources.evidence_location: PDF pp.4-7: ability/style/results pre-assessment; program card fields; initial race allocation considering ability/style/region balance; bicycle/gear recording; substitutions; day-2+ progression based on finish; reprogramming after cancellation.

sources.title: 競輪の審判の要領
sources.evidence_location: p.0 amendment header; judging criteria sections including pressure/push, inside/outer-band rules, nakawari, exemptions, disqualification/major caution/caution; photo-finish roles and track-line definitions.

sources.title: 競走車安全基準

sources.title: 競輪に係る業務の方法に関する規程
sources.evidence_location: Current web body includes evaluation-point / average competition-score calculation context and treatment of DQ/absence in evaluation.

sources.title: 検索・資料室
sources.evidence_location: Search form exposes rider filters including prefecture, graduation term, class, district, age, home bank/home velodrome and riding style; data-room link followed.

sources.title: 競輪資料室
sources.evidence_location: Links current selection criteria, tournament/prize tables, bank records, rule excerpts, registered bicycle list, certified component manufacturers, and Q&A.

sources.title: 出走表を見る｜競輪ガイド
sources.evidence_location: Racecard field definitions include rider name, registered prefecture, style, class, graduation term, age; competition score is described as a strength score calculated from the recent four months; finishing methods are displayed.

sources.title: バンクレコード
